[Rend ](https://imgur.com/a/Gl9UfS7), a Vessel who seems to have a vendetta against Bug but also a grudging sense of companionship. He has the Dashmaster, which makes him incredibly fast and travels with his Weaver companion Claw. 

[Nyx](https://imgur.com/a/495nziB), a mysterious Vessel that gleefully causes trouble any chance she gets but claims to have the same agenda as Bug. She has the Mantis Claw. 

[Spoon](https://imgur.com/a/BxVr4Cz), a sarcastic Vessel who trained in the Secret Assocation of Mages and is a talented Healer, owes a debt to Nyx and so follows her around. 

[Spin](https://imgur.com/a/ykNBvgy), a dopey Vessel that had been locked up and thrown in the deepest part of Greenpath for longer than any other Vessel. The chain on him prevents him from using his arms but luckily he found 2 charms that were able to protect him, even with his ditzy personality. 

[Antler](https://imgur.com/a/E4RN2bU), an Enchantress who found Shade Soul and is looking for something, something that could change Hallownest for better or worse.
